CustomField.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses that receive the fraud alert email when the fraud alert Flow trips a warning (reCAPTCHA score below threshold, Shared IP Warning, or IP Location Match Warning) on an application submission. Admin-tunable without a deploy.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Comma-separated list of email addresses to notify when a fraud warning is triggered on a submission (e.g. admissions-fraud-review@stthomas.edu).
CustomField.label: Fraud Alert Recipient Emails
